About Our School

Nurturing excellence and building futures from Creche to Junior High School since 1999.

Welcome to Golden Child Complex School

Established in 1999, Golden Child Complex School has been a beacon of educational excellence in Ghana. We offer comprehensive education from Creche to Junior High School, focusing on academic excellence, character development, and nurturing each child's unique talents.

What began at a single campus in James Town has grown into one school family across four campuses, so more children can learn close to home.

Established in 1999Our first campus opened at James Town
Four campusesJames Town, First Stop, Abaase and Kasoa-Ofankor
Led by our Proprietor, Dr. EvansWho built the Abaase campus in 2008

Our Story

How Golden Child grew, one campus at a time.

  1. 1999

    James Town, our first campus

    Golden Child School opens at James Town, the storied metropolis of the school, teaching Creche to Primary 3.

  2. Second campus

    First Stop

    First Stop becomes the perpetual heartbeat of Golden Child School, home to the majority of our students and the campus that teaches all the way to JHS 3.

  3. 2008

    Abaase

    Our Proprietor, Dr. Evans, builds the third campus at Abaase, teaching Creche to Primary 3.

  4. Fourth campus

    Kasoa-Ofankor

    The fourth campus extends quality education further, again from Creche to Primary 3.

Mission & Vision

Our Mission

To provide a stimulating learning environment that encourages students to realize their full potential, develop critical thinking skills, and become responsible global citizens.

Our Vision

To be the leading educational institution that produces well-rounded, innovative, and ethical leaders who positively impact society.

Our Core Values

Excellence

Striving for the highest standards in all endeavors

Integrity

Upholding honesty, ethics, and moral principles

Respect

Valuing diversity and treating everyone with dignity

Innovation

Embracing creativity and forward-thinking approaches
